name: Mobvista Inc.
summary: Mobvista Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of advertising and marketing technology services required to develop the mobile internet ecosystem in Singapore, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. It operates through Ad-tech (Advertising Technology Business) and Mar-tech (Marketing Technology Business) segments. The company offers mobile advertising services through a programmatic advertising platform and affiliate ad-serving platform; mobile application data analytics service through SaaS platforms; and cloud-native technology services, as well as develops and sells customized data analytics software.
